simple.summary: אֲדֹנִי־צֶדֶק (ʼĂdônîy-Tsedeq) means Adoni-Tsedek , a Canaanitish king First listed occurrence: Josh 10 1.

definitions.full: H139. Adoni -tsedeq אֲדֹנִיצֶֿ֫דֶק proper name, masculine Canaanite king of Jerusalem Josh 10:1 , 3 ( Lord of righteousness; my lord is righteous , or my Lord is ‚idiq — divine name — compare אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ צֶדֶק, מַלְכִּי , Phoenician אדנבעל etc.)
